description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hopeful Eidolon, adding {W}.
When Hopeful Eidolon dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hopeful Eidolon on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Hopeful Eidolon from your library.
Cast Hopeful Eidolon by paying {W}.
Repeat.
